title: 第3章 开荒除草
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“知道了，给你好评。”

    花期面无表情地签完单子，火速在下面的五颗星上打了勾。

    机器人的屏幕又跳了跳，回收单子看见五颗星，头顶的竹蜻蜓呜呜地转了两圈。

    “客人，您真是人美心善，能为您服务是我的荣幸。”

    它兴奋得身体飘了起来，转头屏幕一闪，爱心消失，变成一个巨大的厌世脸。

    荣幸个屁，这破工作谁爱干谁干。

    还有那个可恶的人类，你才是怪物，全家都是怪物！！！

    机器人整个背影都写满了怨气，气呼呼地飞走了。

    花期撕开包裹，将手套还有镰刀递给荣华。

    “戴上手套干活，用镰刀割断根茎就行，不用担心断根。”

    她自己也戴上手套，拿着另一把镰刀走到旁边去割草。

    荣华惊诧地看着机器人远去，她好像从这个铁疙瘩身上感觉到了不开心。

    瞥了眼身后的城主，她已经戴好手套去拔草了。

    荣华咽下想问的心思，乖乖戴上手套干活。

    手套很轻薄，一戴上就仿佛感知不到存在，而且透气性好，手也不闷汗。

    荣华在手套上看来看去，脑里诞生了一个疑惑。

    这种手套要是能戴回去，夫君他们以后干活是不是能保护手了？

    日头当空，两人大汗淋漓地在地里专心拔草。

    荣华穿着长裙，干活时身上都快要热死了。

    但她不敢喊停，旁边的城主都没停下也没喊过累，她要喊停绝对会被嫌弃。

    她想着花期答应的仙丹，握着镰刀的手就更有劲了。

    一大把又一大把野草被扔到种植区外，一块块荒地被清理干净。

    身旁，埋头干了一上午活，一直在等着荣华询问休息的花期，停了两下都没听到身后人说话。

    她不由偏头，荣华正干得十分起劲，别说喊累了，后背全是汗水都没说一句热。

    反观花期，虽然穿着透气的长裙，身上的汗水却能打湿一张报纸了。

    她累得吐出一口浊气，看了下终端的时间，中午十一点半，可以休息了。

    “可以了，上午工作就到这里，先休息吧！”
content_en:
"I know, I'll give you a good review."

    Huaqi finished signing the order with an expressionless face and quickly ticked the five stars below.

    The robot's screen jumped again, the recycling list saw five stars, and the bamboo dragonfly above its head whined twice.

    "Guest, you are really a kind-hearted person. It is my honor to serve you."

    It was so excited that its body floated up. It turned its head and the screen flashed. The love disappeared and turned into a huge world-weary face.

    You're so lucky, whoever wants to do this crappy job can do it.

    And that hateful human being, you are the monster, and the whole family is a monster! ! !

    The robot's entire back was filled with resentment, and it flew away angrily.

    Hua Qi tore open the package and handed the gloves and sickle to Rong Hua.

    "Wear gloves when working and just use a sickle to cut off the rhizomes. You don't have to worry about breaking the roots."

    She put on gloves herself and walked over with another scythe to cut the grass.

    Ronghua watched the robot go away in amazement. She seemed to feel unhappiness from this iron lump.

    Glancing at the city lord behind her, she had already put on gloves to pull weeds.

    Ronghua swallowed his thoughts and put on his gloves to work.

    The gloves are so light and thin that you can't feel their presence once you put them on. They are also breathable and your hands won't get sweaty.

    Ronghua looked at the gloves, and a doubt arose in his mind.

    If these gloves can be put back on, will my husband and the others be able to protect their hands when working in the future?

    The sun was high in the sky, and the two of them were sweating profusely and concentrating on pulling weeds in the field.

    Ronghua was wearing a long skirt and was almost getting hot while working.

    But she didn't dare to shout stop. The city lord next to her didn't even stop or shouted tired. If she tried to shout stop, she would definitely be disliked.

    She thought about the elixir promised by Huaqi, and her hand holding the sickle became more energetic.

    A handful of weeds were thrown outside the planting area, and patches of wasteland were cleared.

    Beside him, he had been working hard all morning, waiting for Ronghua to ask about the flowering period of rest. He paused twice and didn't hear the person behind him speak.

    She couldn't help but tilt her head, Ronghua was working very hard, not to mention she was tired, her back was covered with sweat and she didn't even say a word about how hot it was.

    On the other hand, during the flowering season, even though she was wearing a breathable long skirt, the sweat on her body could wet a newspaper.

    She was so tired that she let out a breath and looked at the time on the terminal. It was 11:30 noon and she could rest.

    "Okay, that's it for the morning's work. Let's rest first!"
title_en: Chapter 3 Clearing up wasteland and weeding
